notes.title: braverBOTS Demo
notes.content:
[h1]braverBOTS Demo is LIVE[/h1]

Hey all, our first playable look at braverBOTS is LIVE on Steam. We want to make a great game, but we can't do it alone. Your feedback is vital to a healthy, successful project. So please download braverBOTS and help us test and improve our game!

Download our demo here -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157940/braverBOTS/
